name: Constraint System Formulation
description: Replaces the physical vehicle overlap rules with a formal system of inequalities (Deadline, Causality, Mutual Exclusion). The relaxed scenarios explicitly drop certain inequalities, forcing the model to algebraically deduce that `JOB i` implies $p_{i,1} + p_{i,2} > T$ and `LOAD c` implies $\sum p_{k,c} > T$, bypassing the pattern matching of "lane sums" and "team lengths".
